decision_policy: Investigation thresholds, not permission to relax compatibility. Correctness and sample admission precede all comparisons. Report absolute deltas and exploratory intervals; no universal speed or non-inferiority claim.

finite_latency.material_increase: both >10% and >2 ms versus Go; shared implemented commands also compare accepted prior Rust

cpu.material_increase: both >15% and >2 ms total client CPU versus Go; normalized CPU/row must use identical complete row counts

peak_rss.material_increase: both >25% and >8 MiB versus Go; report unconditional absolute RSS as well

throughput.material_decrease: >10% with identical full output/counts and primary/control observer evidence; investigate fixture and sink ceiling before attribution

stream_resources.rss: After warmup, inspect raw traces and regression slope. Sustained >256 KiB/min growth in bounded steady/idle/dictionary conditions triggers investigation/repetition; no extrapolation from short samples. Dictionary delta growth is separately explained.
stream_resources.fd: Any monotonic growth beyond transient connection replacements triggers investigation; inspect counts, not only fitted slope.
stream_resources.threads: Unexplained upward trend after initialization triggers investigation.

statistics.intervals: existing pointwise independent bootstrap; exploratory, no simultaneous or paired inference
statistics.soak_first_tier: one independent 30-minute session per implementation and mode; descriptive screening only
statistics.soak_replicated_tier: three sessions per implementation/mode subject to separate quiet windows; repeat material regressions using a new seed and retain both runs

controls: separate full versus hash-framing collector reports
fixture CPU and expected-output encoding wall time annotated
profiles/diagnostics/build cost excluded from native release timings
prior_rust: Only previously implemented shared commands; no prior Rust Flight baseline
quiet_window: Common nonblocking /home/ajs/.cache/pb-rs-performance.lock plus explicit companion pause acknowledgement; bounded campaign deadline and cleanup reserve; release between modes.
pre_campaign_review_change: Added observer/interference/admission controls after independent measurement review r1, before any native timing campaign; original practical regression thresholds unchanged.

cpu_ceiling_screen.meaning: CPU seconds divided by native client elapsed seconds, not percentage of all host cores. Threshold flags potential fixture/observer limits; it is not causal proof of saturation. Suppress throughput ratios when flagged, retain absolute values and raw CPU deltas.

interference_screen.meaning: System busy CPU delta minus separately observed client, fixture and collector CPU, divided by elapsed observation seconds. Record raw components; clamp only derived negative residual to zero. Below minimum duration report resolution_limited, not clean. A flag invalidates comparative timing admission; quiet handshake and A/A controls remain required.

intervals.duration_tiers: No bootstrap confidence intervals. Report per-session values and range; n<=3 is descriptive only.
intervals.finite_method: Existing pointwise exploratory bootstrap only; no simultaneous or non-inferiority inference.

campaign_controls.duration_order: Explicit alternating AB/BA by session index; record chosen order, derive workload seed from stable workload identity.
campaign_controls.quiet_window: Require full scheduled duration partition including contract A/A controls and conservative timeout/cleanup reserves to fit before acquiring lock.
campaign_controls.budgets_binding: Parent manifest budget content must equal this file; record SHA256 and verify identity at window end.
campaign_controls.timing_aa: Separate finite Go-versus-same-Go 5 warmups and30 measured samples per label before practical regression interpretation; not pooled with candidate comparisons.
campaign_controls.metric_scope: Keep sink_gated or schedule_bound metrics absolute only; exclude their ratios and practical budget classification.

resource_pressure_workloads.dictionary_expanded_bytes: 16/32/48/64 MiB cycles with16MiB reset;9 batches then500ms open-stream hold
resource_pressure_workloads.purpose: Observe large dictionary ownership, decompression expansion and post-burst RSS with bounded collection; not primary latency or a universal throughput claim.
resource_pressure_workloads.wire_gate: Actual encoded Flight message must remain within4194304-byte cap; verify functional Go/Rust output before timed admission.
